passages.text: We know that this is the ideal — to give up after seeing and experiencing the vanity of things. Having found out that the heart of the material world is a mere hollow, containing only ashes, give it up and go back.
passages.note: Letting go after seeing the emptiness of pursuits

passages.text: Stand and die in your own strength, if there is any sin in the world, it is weakness; avoid all weakness, for weakness is sin, weakness is death.
passages.note: Inner strength against weakness and dependence

passages.text: Stand on your own feet, and assimilate what you can; learn from every nation, take what is of use to you.
passages.note: Self-reliance while staying open to learning
